crossRefs.note: Before the length of one hundred cubits was the north door, and the width was fifty cubits.

translations.web: The way before them was like the appearance of the rooms which were toward the north; according to their length so was their width: and all their exits were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.
translations.bsb: with a passageway in front of them, just like the chambers that were on the north. They had the same length and width, with similar exits and dimensions.
translations.kjv: And the way before them was like the appearance of the chambers which were toward the north, as long as they, and as broad as they: and all their goings out were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.
translations.asv: And the way before them was like the appearance of the way of the chambers which were toward the north; according to their length so was their breadth: and all their egresses were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.
